function.name: lml_chat
function.description: Get cross-domain taste recommendations from Like Me Like via natural language. Returns a text reply plus a structured recommendations array. Use this for any 'recommend me X based on Y' question across films, books, music, food, places, etc.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale, e.g. 'en' or 'nl'. Drives reply language.

liked_items.description: 1-5 items the end-user has explicitly loved. Highest-impact signal.

taste_signals.description: Preferences that are NOT catalog works: abstract vibes, values, rituals, pet peeves ('quiet Sunday mornings', 'rejects fast fashion'). Use INSTEAD of liked_items when there's no specific title. Each entry: {text, polarity?: 'like'|'dislike', reason?}.

display_name.description: End-user's first name or handle (max 40 chars).

gift_mode.description: True when the recommendation is for someone else.

function.name: lml_recommend_scoped
function.description: Get a single recommendation in a specific category, given a seed item the user loves. Use when the user explicitly asks for one pick in one category.

function.name: lml_disambiguate
function.description: Resolve an ambiguous title to ranked candidates from the items catalog. Use BEFORE recommend_* when the seed could match multiple things.

function.name: lml_query_items
function.description: Structured catalog query for CRITERIA requests that fit neither a title lookup nor a seed-based recommend: 'Italian films from the 70s', 'melancholic atmospheric albums'. Semantic-similarity ranked, personalized when the user is known, already-rated titles excluded. FREE — never consumes a call credit.

description.description: Free-text taste/topic description to rank by.

origin_lang.description: ISO-639-1 origin language of the WORK ('it' = Italian-origin), not the reply language.

function.name: lml_get_popular
function.description: What's popular right now, per locale + categories — the same feed the Like Me Like homepage shows, biased to the user's taste cohort when known. Use for 'what's trending?' / 'give me a starting point' with NO seed item. FREE — never consumes a call credit.
